name: SSHI_DoubleL_Filter
rationale: The SSHI_PiFilter was very close to passing, but failed slightly on ripple and startup. The Pi filter (C-L-C) provided good ripple suppression but slowed down the cold start. A Double-L filter (L-C-L-C) offers even more aggressive ripple attenuation (second-order filtering at the output) while potentially allowing for a smaller first capacitor (C2), which can speed up the initial charging process compared to a Pi filter. By using two inductors (L2, L3) and two capacitors (C2, C1), we create a low-pass structure that should push the ripple below 20 mV while keeping the total capacitance manageable for startup within 0.15 s.
